args.text:
Batch: 15 runs. 6 accepted (r02, r04, r06, r07, r10, r12), 4 declined, 5 not reported.
Flagged (2): r06 and r07. Reason: a check failed but the run was accepted. Closure was 2.928 and 2.915 against a threshold of 1.0. This means the tip motion from the midline and stage log does not match the tip motion from the tracked kinematics.
Cleared (4): r02, r04, r10 and r12. Rigid-body invariance and closure pass. Every summary is close to the batch, with |z| ≤ 1.43: REGR peak, peak position, growth-zone length, flank difference and width-free ratio. No roll-backs. Plane sections is above its threshold on r04, r10 and r12, but that check is not run under the width-free ratio, so this is expected.
What the flagged runs have in common: the closure failure is the only fault. Their strain-rate profiles match the batch (peak about 42 %/h at 316 µm, growth zone 526–537 µm), so the problem is the tip-motion data, not the root's growth. The velocity and strain-rate fields of r06 and r07 should not be reported until closure is fixed.
